Lights Out Game

The classic 5×5 Lights Out — every board is generated from solvable reverse moves. Turn all the lights off!

0
Moves

Turn off all the lights!

📖 How to use

  1. Press New Game for a fresh board.
  2. Tap lights — each toggles its neighbors too.
  3. Turn every light off to win.
  4. Use as few moves as possible!

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I play?

Pressing a light toggles it plus its four neighbors. The goal is all lights off.

Is every puzzle solvable?

Every board is made by applying random presses to the solved state, so a solution always exists.

How is the move counter used?

The counter tracks your presses — fewer moves means a better score.

Can I get a new puzzle?

Yes — press New Game for a fresh solvable board.
